name: CENTCOM HQ
desc: The Draconis Alliance CENTCOM is the uncompromising answer to the question of Fafnir’s security. Conceived in the earliest days of the alliance, this massive subterranean complex serves as the strategic brain and backbone of the system’s spaceborne defenses, and is home to the Alliance Intelligence Office. Rumours persist that there is some hidden Domain-era technology buried deep within the core. The 'Office' assures that this is entirely false.

name: Orbital Station - Draconis
desc:
The Alliance's own orbital watchful bulwark - a central docking hub flanked by twin weapon platforms and hangar decks, built to CENTCOM specifications rather than scavenged from a wreck. Heavy ballistic and missile batteries cover every approach, with multiple fighters wings held in reserve for anything that gets past them.

Must be reduced before a bombardment can be attempted.
